attributes.name: Druva - Unusual Data Activity Followed by Quarantine
attributes.description: Correlates unusual data activity with subsequent quarantine of the same protected resource.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Correlates unusual data activity with subsequent quarantine of the same protected resource.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name)
  )

| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.alert.name),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL is_uda =
    druva.uda.type IS NOT NULL
    OR event_text LIKE "*unusual data activity*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*data anomaly*"

| EVAL is_quarantine =
    event_text LIKE "*quarantine*"
    OR druva.event_type == "Added To Quarantine Bay"

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| WHERE resource IS NOT NULL
    AND (is_uda OR is_quarantine)

| STATS
    uda_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_uda,

    quarantine_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_quarantine,

    first_uda =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE is_uda,

    first_quarantine =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE is_quarantine,

    uda_types =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.uda.type)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    alert_names =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.alert.name)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    quarantine_actions =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)
        WHERE is_quarantine,

    uda_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    quarantine_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_quarantine

  BY resource

| WHERE uda_count > 0
    AND quarantine_count > 0
    AND first_quarantine >= first_uda

| EVAL minutes_to_quarantine =
    DATE_DIFF(
      "minutes",
      first_uda,
      first_quarantine
    )
